collateralizationRatio.rationale: AlchemistV2 enforces a hard per-position minimum collateralization of 2.0 (minimumCollateralization()=2e18 at block 25627228) so no mint/withdraw can leave a position below 200% collateralization, but the contract exposes no global aggregate debt or system collateralization accessor (totalDebt/getTotalDebt/totalValue-style system getters are absent; totalValue is per-owner). A single live system CR therefore cannot be read on-chain. The meaningful verifiable collateralization fact is the 200% per-position floor, recorded under collateralizationParameters. Dual-source: on-chain minimumCollateralization eth_call + Alchemist docs stating 2:1 minimum / 50% max LTV.

liquidationCapacityRatio.rationale: Alchemix v2 has no stability pool or committed external liquidation capital. Positions are non-forcibly-liquidatable by third parties; borrowers self-liquidate against their own collateral, and the Transmuter provides eventual 1:1 alUSD→underlying conversion from harvested yield, repayments, and self-liquidations. There is no pool-to-supply ratio expressible as committed liquidation capacity. Dual-source: Alchemix overview (no forced liquidations) + Transmuter docs (time-based 1:1 conversion, not a liquidation pool).

collateralizationParameters.basis: Hard on-chain floor: minimumCollateralization()=2e18 (200%) verified at finalized block 25627228 on AlchemistV2 0x5C6374a2…94dd; debtToken()=alUSD 0xBC6DA0FE…60E9; docs independently state max 50% LTV / 2:1 collateral-to-debt and that withdrawals that would breach the floor are blocked. Adequate rather than strong: no live system-wide CR measurement and strategy-level deposit caps / max-loss pauses are governance parameters rather than a continuously published stress band.

liquidationMechanics.basis: No third-party liquidation engine. Borrowers may self-liquidate collateral into debt repayment while remaining above the 2:1 floor (Alchemist docs). Forced liquidations are explicitly disclaimed on the product overview. Limited: self-liquidation plus Transmuter conversion is a defined path, but there is no protocol-run auction or keeper liquidation of underwater accounts because accounts are designed not to be forcibly liquidatable.

backstop.basis: Transmuter receives harvested yield (after 10% protocol fee), repayments, and self-liquidations and converts alUSD to underlying 1:1 over time (Transmuter docs). Elixir AMO is documented as a related market operator for excess capital. Limited: conversion is flow-rate constrained by yield/repayments rather than a pre-funded insurance pool sized against supply; no measured backstop capital ratio is published.

branchIsolation.basis: Single AlchemistV2 debt system for alUSD with multiple supported yield tokens/underlyings sharing one debt accounting (Alchemist docs: one alAsset per Alchemist, multiple strategies). Strategies have deposit caps and max-loss pause safeguards, but bad-strategy performance socializes through the shared alUSD debt surface rather than fully isolated per-collateral branches. Limited isolation.

structuralRedemption.basis: Holders can deposit alUSD into the Transmuter for eventual 1:1 conversion to underlying as flow accrues (Transmuter docs + Alchemist integration). This is not same-block unrestricted redeemability against all system collateral; flow is yield/repayment-gated. Dual-source: Transmuter documentation + Alchemist description of Transmuter as the conversion sink.
